name: radix-dialog
title: Radix Dialog
description: An accessible modal dialog built on Radix UI with smooth Motion spring entrance and exit animations.

agentMetadata.intent: Present focused modal content with Radix focus and portal semantics.
a11yConstraints: Keep focus trapped and provide Dialog.Title and Dialog.Description.
agentMetadata.motionEngine: Motion scale, perspective, and backdrop presence transition.
compositionRules: Use Radix Dialog.Trigger and render one semantic trigger element.
compositionRecipes: Compose with radix/button for confirmation actions.
